title: Install, First Launch and Settings | LayerCue from Zero, Episode 2
description:
Get LayerCue onto your Mac or Windows PC, see what's there the first time you open it, sign in once for Settings, and learn the General, Files and Tools pages (including where your media goes) and how to quit safely.
New here? Start with Episode 1: Meet LayerCue — The Main Window.
Recorded on LayerCue 0.9.12.
Mac download: https://layercue.com/download/  ·  Windows: Microsoft Store (search LayerCue, published by CastPad)
Manual: https://layercue.com/docs/start/install/
The narration is AI-generated and the music is built from GarageBand loops. The install screens are illustrations; the sign-in panel is from the manual.
playlist: LayerCue from Zero: Run Your First Show

description_ko:
Mac이나 Windows PC에 LayerCue를 설치하고, 처음 열었을 때 무엇이 있는지 살펴봐요. 설정을 위해 한 번 로그인하고, General·Files·Tools 페이지(미디어가 저장되는 곳 포함)와 안전하게 끄는 법을 배워요.
Mac 다운로드: https://layercue.com/download/ · Windows: Microsoft Store(LayerCue 검색, 게시자 CastPad)
설치 화면은 그림이고, 로그인 화면은 매뉴얼의 이미지예요.
처음이라면 1편 「LayerCue 메인 창」부터 보세요.
LayerCue 0.9.12로 녹화했어요.
매뉴얼: https://layercue.com/docs/start/install/
나레이션은 AI 음성이고, 음악은 GarageBand 루프로 만들었어요. 데모의 행사·인물·미디어는 가상이에요.
description_ja:
Mac または Windows PC に LayerCue をインストールし、初めて開いたときの中身を確認します。設定のために一度ログインし、General・Files・Tools ページ(メディアの保存先を含む)と安全な終了方法を学びます。
Mac のダウンロード: https://layercue.com/download/ ・ Windows: Microsoft Store(LayerCue で検索、発行元 CastPad)
インストール画面はイラスト、ログイン画面はマニュアルの画像です。
初めての方は第1回「LayerCue のメインウィンドウ」からどうぞ。
LayerCue 0.9.12 で収録しています。
マニュアル: https://layercue.com/docs/start/install/
ナレーションは AI 音声、音楽は GarageBand のループで作っています。デモのイベント・人物・メディアは架空のものです。
